header.name: Introduction to Fintech
header.description: The course is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental concepts, principles, and applications of financial technology (FinTech). The course aims to equip students with the necessary knowledge and skills to navigate the rapidly evolving landscape of Fintech and its impact on the financial industry.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Develop an understanding of how FinTech is reconfiguring financial services business models and how they differ from traditional business models.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Understand the fintech landscape - technologies, platforms, and innovations shaping the financial industry.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Identify the disruptive potential of fintech innovations in the banking sector and NBFCs, focusing on payments and lending.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Develop an understanding of the emerging use cases and the underlying technology across the insurance, real estate and investment sector.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Analyze Fintech's regulatory and legal challenges, including privacy, data security, consumer protection, and compliance with financial regulations.
